title: Rehoboam's Wives, Children, and Heir
description: The chapter concludes with an overview of Rehoboam's family: his wives Mahalath and Maakah, his eighteen other wives and sixty concubines, as well as his twenty-eight sons and sixty daughters. He loved Maakah the most and appointed her son Abijah as leader among his brothers to make him king. Wisely, he scattered the other sons throughout the fortified cities of Judah and Benjamin, providing them with abundant supplies and many wives.
